$comment: Records the commit of each independently-versioned subproject that together form a working set. The three app repos have their own remotes and are NOT tracked by this repository; liveKit-video-infra IS tracked here. Verify with `npm run pin:check`, restore with `npm run pin:sync`, re-pin with `npm run pin:update`.
note: User-facing copy renamed from Mohuddle to Patvero across the backend, with web and mobile contracts regenerated to match. The Mohuddle identity provider integration and the mohuddle_user_id primary key are intentionally unchanged.
